data.body: **[P1] Do not treat mutable stable external references as replay-safe.** This invocation-local generation only invalidates cached objects. If a SerDes overwrites a deterministic external key and the invocation stops before the new operation update commits, the old checkpoint retains the same reference but now resolves to uncheckpointed state. Require immutable/versioned references (as `FileSystemSerDes` uses), or include a unique publication version in every returned reference. Add a checkpoint-failure replay test.
